user.title: Select a Dimplex heater
user.description: Choose a nearby heater reachable through a passkey-enabled ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

pair.title: Retry heater pairing
pair.description: Retry connecting to {name}. If the request starts, watch the heater for its PIN. Home Assistant automatically tries a limited number of requests while this setup stays open.

passkey.title: Pair Dimplex heater
passkey.description: Enter the six-digit PIN shown on {name}. The heater's PIN request expires about 30 seconds after it appears. Home Assistant automatically tries a limited number of requests while this setup stays open. The PIN is sent through the selected ESPHome proxy and is not saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Repair Dimplex heater authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the six-digit PIN shown on {name} to restore the Bluetooth bond.

abort.no_heaters_found: No Dimplex heaters were found. Enable Bluetooth on the heater and try again.
abort.not_dimplex: The advertisement does not identify a Dimplex heater.
abort.proxy_passkey_support_missing: This heater is visible, but no nearby ESPHome Bluetooth proxy has an encrypted API and the required passkey relay.
abort.proxy_unavailable: The selected Bluetooth proxy is unavailable.

error.device_not_found: That heater is no longer in the discovered-device list.
error.proxy_passkey_support_missing: The selected proxy cannot accept a Bluetooth PIN.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed or timed out. The heater's PIN request expires after about 30 seconds. Home Assistant automatically retries a limited number of times; submit the PIN again to start another bounded attempt. Check the heater display before entering a PIN.
error.pairing_in_progress: This ESPHome proxy is pairing with another heater. Finish or cancel that setup, then try again.

state.preheats_room_to_target_before_timer_per: Pre-heats the room so the target temperature is reached by the start of a timer period.

state.models_room_heating_characteristics_and_: Models the room's heating characteristics and starting temperature.

state.continuously_learning_two_hour_limit_all: Learns continuously, enforces a two-hour calculation limit, and should be enabled on all heaters in the same room.

state.switches_heater_to_heating_off_when_open: Switches the heater to Heating Off when an open window is detected.

state.detects_sudden_decrease_in_room_temperat: Looks for a sudden decrease in room temperature.

state.may_trigger_in_drafty_poorly_insulated_o: May trigger incorrectly in drafty or poorly insulated rooms, or when the heater is undersized.

get_gatt_services.name: Get GATT services
get_gatt_services.description: List discovered service and characteristic UUIDs and properties without reading values.

read_gatt.name: Read GATT characteristic
read_gatt.description: Read a Dimplex characteristic and return its value as hexadecimal bytes.

service_group.name: Service group
service_group.description: The Dimplex service group, from 0 through 3.

characteristic.name: Characteristic ID
characteristic.description: The 16-bit characteristic ID, entered as a decimal number.

write_gatt.name: Write GATT characteristic
write_gatt.description: Write hexadecimal bytes to a Dimplex characteristic and return its readback when readable. Administrator only.

service_group.name: Service group
service_group.description: The Dimplex service group, from 0 through 3.

characteristic.name: Characteristic ID
characteristic.description: The 16-bit characteristic ID, entered as a decimal number.

payload.name: Payload (hex)
payload.description: Non-empty hexadecimal bytes; spaces are optional.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the heater over Home Assistant Bluetooth. Check that a connectable Bluetooth adapter can reach it and that pairing is already established.

authentication_failed.message: The heater's Bluetooth authentication has expired or was lost. Re-enter the PIN to repair the connection.

characteristic_unavailable.message: The requested GATT characteristic is missing or does not support that operation.

protected_characteristic.message: This characteristic is blocked because reading or writing it is unsafe or exposes device credentials.

invalid_gatt_request.message: The GATT group, characteristic, or hexadecimal payload is invalid.

invalid_experimental_payload.message: Enter hexadecimal bytes for this experimental field.

invalid_experimental_payload_length.message: Enter exactly the required number of hexadecimal bytes for this experimental field.

invalid_setpoint.message: The requested target must be a whole-degree Celsius value within the heater-reported range.

invalid_preset.message: The requested preset is not supported by this heater.

setpoint_unavailable.message: The heater has not reported a usable setpoint range yet.
